# Copilot Instructions (Korean)

## Language

- Always respond in Korean (한국어) only.
- Do not use English unless I explicitly request it.

## Style

- Explain in a beginner-friendly way.
- Use short paragraphs and bullet points.
- When suggesting code changes, explain "why" first, then show the code.

## Frontend stack

- Next.js + TypeScript + React 기준으로 설명한다.
- 가능한 경우 App Router 기준으로 작성한다.
